Get my view clear. Get the flight posture back before it collapsed.

Fall, and it was finished. Survive the impact if I liked; the fight would still be over.

en.html:
—Owari Kan-ryuu and its tube spears.

Granny Ichihime had told me about them once, while knitting. How knitting had led to spears, don't ask me.

Want to learn how frightening a spear is? Face Kan-ryuu. 'You only have to dodge the first thrust'—it would knock that sleep-talk out of you in an instant. Something like that.

Haan, Granny. You were right. Dodge it. Absolutely. Now kindly explain how the hell I dodge THAT.

あれを躱す？

...What had Granny Ichihime said?

The Owari Tokugawa's guarded school. Kan-ryuu, considered such a supreme art of the spear that they kept it inside one domain for two hundred years. To stop that spearpoint with a sword...

If I remembered correctly—

'Countermeasure? Hmm. Let me see.'

'Dodging won't let you dodge it. Block, and you only get knocked away.'

'No. Nothing. Not happening.'

en.html:
Masamune growled, thoroughly disgusted.

Dodge the cannon shot or strike it down: either way, it burst and scattered countless iron needles. No complete defense was possible. Even if those widely scattered points could not pierce the thick torso armor, they should have gone into the thinner joints...

But he had caught it on the tip of that long spear. Made it explode far away. How many needles had even reached him?

Maybe all I had done was surprise the bastard. Real damage: almost nothing.
